notes.title: Update Notes For March 22
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

First of all, thank you for playing this game and sending me lots of comments!

In this update, we changed the previously inconvenient system.


[h2]Changes[/h2]

- Changed saving algorithm to enable data recovery. Apologize because you can't continue the game with your previous data.
( If you want to CONTINUE from your last save, please send an e-mail to contact@bhaptics.com )

- You can now move freely even when system messages pop up. But there are still a few remaining.

- Significantly reduced lines and missions to help you move quickly through the tutorial.

- Added hold grab option. You can change the grab mode from Settings.

- The default movement speed has been increased slightly.

- The UI of the main menu, in-game setup menu, and loading scene have been changed.

- Added haptic patterns that works with [i]bHaptics[/i] devices. Now you can feel the haptics in various situation.


It's a short game, but thank you again to everyone who played and gave us feedback!

For bugs and other inquiries, please report to contact@bhaptics.com.
